# Introduction
## Fieldwork

![](//data/assets/20250520_coupling/fieldwork.webp){fig-alt="Joren and Mathias during fieldwork."}

---

```{r watina-map}
#| code-fold: true
#| eval: false
require("n2khab")
require("mapview")
# require("watina")
require("dplyr")
require("sf")
source("./watina_migration.R")

flanders <- n2khab::read_admin_areas() # dsn = "provinces"
m1 <- mapview::mapview(flanders, col.regions = "white", alpha.regions = 0.6)
# TODO: I could not get provinces

conn <- connect_watina()
watina_locations <- get_locs(conn) %>%
  select(area_code, loc_code, x, y) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  filter(
    area_code != "VBS",
    if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x))
    ) %>% 
  collect() %>%
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 31370)

m2 <- mapview(
  watina_locations,
  map.types = c("CartoDB.DarkMatter"),
  cex = 3,
  col.regions = "orange"
)

m1+m2
```

## code

```{.python code-line-numbers="6-8"}
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

r = np.arange(0, 2, 0.01)
theta = 2 * np.pi * r
fig, ax = plt.subplots(subplot_kw={'projection': 'polar'})
ax.plot(theta, r)
ax.set_rticks([0.5, 1, 1.5, 2])
ax.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
